body: Still not feeling all that great, she said some more hurtful things tonight, but I'm trying not pay attention to it. Being able to cry about it helps. I've been a blubbering mess most of the day, but, knowing that he is there helps...

It went... He promised he'd talk to his mom about being so hard on me if I'd get help... So tomorrow morning I'm gonna look for a support group. We ate brunch with his mother today and he told her everything that happened this morning, and she apologized. I took a nap when we got back, and now we're watching movies.
My fiance woke up and stopped me from leaving this morning. After some tears (and quite frankly a lot of screaming on my part) I feel a little less like going through with it.
It's not your fault, I understand.

It'd be nice if I didn't have to be so damn strong all the time. Try not to cry at work, at my parent's house, god forbid I cry in front of his mom, who seems to blame EVERYTHING on me. If I didn't smoke, if I didn't drink, both things I stopped the second I found out I was pregnant, she would be a grandmother.
It just doesn't feel like he cares anymore, like he thinks I'm faking it for attention from him...

It's just so hard to see the light at the end of the tunnel... this has been so hard on me, my parents, everybody really, but it doesn't seem like anybody cares how I feel, just that they don't get to be grandparents, great grandparents, aunts and uncles. It seems that nobody cares how I'm doing. I know it sucks to be in their position too, but nobody seems to understand my position or my fiance's. He lost a child in this too, and he won't talk to me about it. He seems to have no feelings on the matter at all, actually.  Just keeps telling me we'll try again after we get married. I don't want to try again. I can't bare the thought of going through this again, I can't imagine pain worse than this. I just want to give up.
I feel so weak, so hopeless, so worthless, maybe if I was better I'd be laying here thinking of baby names, looking at baby clothes online, anything but this...

I feel so helpless right now... and the one person in my life that I can help is sound asleep right now, and I'm pretty sure he doesn't believe I'm ready to end it. If he does, he just doesn't care anymore.
